Island Transport Academy — sunny Taiwan coastal picture-book, premium preschool game art for ages 3–8. Clearly DIFFERENT silhouette from normal hands-on-backpack standing and from walking or sitting. Cheerful reassuring expressions. View from front, facing slightly LEFT toward cabin. No door frame or floor should be rendered; just the three separated cutout sprites. Same head height and foot baseline across three. Large clean silhouette readable at 64px. Transparent alpha background. No text, labels, panels, props, chairs or shadows. Return local generated file path.

Each full child including BOTH hands must fit within width 330px in its own column; do not stretch arms wider than this. Reduce arm reach rather than crop any fingers. No glows, gradients, backdrop, atmosphere, floor or contact shadows. Every pixel between children is transparent. Their feet stay fully inside canvas, and the art itself is opaque.
